A surge of moisture associated with the northern edge of Invest 99W
is expected to bring increased showers and isolated thunderstorms for
Guam and Rota by late tonight or early Saturday and continuing
through Sunday. Rainfall accumulations will likely be highest over
Guam and decrease to the north with increased distance from 99W.
However, a heavy shower or two cannot be ruled out for Tinian and 
Saipan. If 99W slowly strengthens as expected, then increased trade 
winds will move in by Sunday for all islands. However, uncertainty 
is high as models struggle to agree on the timing, location, and 
speed of a tropical disturbance that could form in central Micronesia
and travel westward, bringing said weather conditions to the region.
We will continue to monitor and communicate any updates as necessary.
Models show a continued wet pattern for Guam and Rota through next 
week with lower shower chances for islands north of Guam. Another
surge of moisture is possible from Invest 90W by the middle of next 
week but uncertainty remains high for the exact location and strength
of this system.

Marine...
Buoy and altimetry data show a steady trade wind swell, with combined
seas of 5 to 6 feet, increasing just slightly Sunday and potentially
peaking Monday at 5 to 7 feet depending on the strength of Invest
99W. There is a moderate risk of rip currents along north- and east-
facing reefs that is expected to linger through at least early next 
week. Surf and combined seas are unlikely to reach hazardous levels,
but will be closely monitored as Invests 99W and 90W develop over the
next few days.

Tropical Systems...
Things have gotten more interesting today, as the Joint Typhoon 
Warning Center has dubbed Invests 99W, which is located west- 
northwest of Chuuk, near 6.7N 147.9E (near Pikelot). Then, much 
further east-southeast we have Invest 90W located south of 
Ebon/southwest of Majuro near 2.3N 168.7E. Both of these systems are
rated as sub-low, this means tropical cyclone development is very
unlikely within the next 24 hours. Both systems are forecasted to 
continue to gradually organize over the next several days. 

At this time, 99W is forecast to track west-northwest and pass 
between Guam and Yap. However, IT'S STILL TOO EARLY to determine how 
close to either location it'll pass by and at what strength it'll be.
With that said, residents across Yap State, can expect to see an 
increase in shower and thunderstorm activity over the weekend and 
into early next week, some of which may be locally heavy with 
convectively-aided wind gusts, some increase in sea heights, and 
reductions in visibilities at times. For Guam and Palau, both may be
an increase in winds and showers potential as the trade-wind inflow 
strengthens over/near Guam and westerly inflow develops over Palau 
as 99W pass between Guam and Yap. Invest 99W is then forecast to 
continue move west-northwest to northwest into the Philippine Sea.

As for Invest 90W, it's already bringing widespread convection to
areas near Majuro and this is expected to continue over the next 24 
hours. Then, eventually doing the same to Kosrae over the weekend 
and to Pohnpei by Monday. Both Kosrae and Pohnpei will likely see 
locally heavy rainfall, gusty convectively-aided wind gusts, some 
increase in sea heights, and reductions in visibilities at times. 
Stay tuned as the forecasts across all regions look to remain fairly 
active over the next several days.

Eastern Micronesia...
See the tropical section above more more detail on Invest 90W. 
In general, a very wet pattern is well-established with most 
locations seeing numerous to widespread shower potential. As such, 
PoPs (Probability of Precipitation) were significantly ramped up 
area-wide, with locally heavy rainfall wording included. This "wet 
wave" of heavy rainfall will transition west from the Majuro Area 
through early next week. The increased cloud cover/density and rain 
rates that are expected will help modify overnight and afternoon 
temperatures, and the forecast has this well in hand. As we head into
the latter half of next week, a much drier and more sunny pattern 
may overspread the region.

For mariners, mainly light to gentle winds will become moderate at
times, with isolated convective gusts near-gale force not out of the
question. Seas look to remain in the 5 to 7 foot range, locally 
higher near Invest 90W and any areas of heavy showers or 
thunderstorms.

Western Micronesia...
A special weather statement has been issued for Yap Proper, Fais, 
Ulithi, and Palau. These islands and atolls are anticipated to in the
path/effects of Invest 99W. More on Invest 99W in the tropical 
section. A wet and unsettled pattern is anticipated for much of the 
region. As Invest 99W moves through the regions showers are expected 
to increase for the northern Yap islands/atolls. Current model 
guidance show Invest 99W passing between Yap Proper and Guam as it 
moves into the Philippine Sea.
